takeaways: The 63.6-point margin was larger than either team's main lineup leak, so the matchup was decided more by raw scoring than one obvious swap.
The clearest unit edge was total RB output: Nacua-Cola by 33.8 points.
Against projection, Nacua-Cola finished +23.3 while Moonbeam Ice Cream finished -33.0.
The biggest started performance was Puka Nacua for Nacua-Cola at 35.7 points.
